interview.name: Mara
interview.answer: The notes do not say when or where the repair drive is being held.

reflections: Mara tends to coordinate the repair drive by giving concrete, task-level instructions.
Leo is responsive and dependable, quickly accepting specific help requests and confirming what he will bring.
Mara and Sam are collaborating in a practical, organized way, with Sam defining priorities and Mara taking on the sorting work.
Mara is consistently dependable and task-focused, especially on sorting and triaging repair work.
Vik is coordinating the broader volunteer lineup and keeping the group aligned by promising updates.
The group works well with clear role assignment, with Mara handling sorting and Uli offering hands-on tool support.
Mara is the main organizer, handling sorting, triage, and follow-up lists for the repair drive.
Vik is coordinating the broader volunteer plan and communicating updates once details are finalized.
The group works cooperatively with clear task delegation, and Rosa helps keep everyone informed and organized.
Mara is coordinating a repair-drive workflow by sorting donations, triaging items that need parts or tools, and keeping the others updated.
The others are responsive and cooperative, each taking a small operational role to keep the event organized.
Clear handoff of lists and updates is important here; Mara’s role is central for routing information to the right people.
Mara is coordinating a shared repair/sorting workflow and routes tasks to others based on parts, tools, and item status.
Dane is focused on logistics support, especially organizing the drop-off spot and tracking incoming items.
Mina and Sam are helping by handling specific checks and matching items to needed tools or parts, so the group is splitting the work into clear roles.

events.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and a few extra gloves?
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and extra gloves.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Mara: Hi Sam — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What needs doing first?
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — first we should sort the donated items and set aside anything that needs tools or spare parts. After that, we can make a quick list of what still needs fixing.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll start sorting the donated items and pull out anything that needs tools or spare parts.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Vik: We’re still lining folks up for the repair drive, so I’ll repeat the full plan once the details are set. Mara, I’ll make sure you get the update too.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep sorting the donated items and setting aside anything that needs tools or spare parts. Just send the full plan when it’s ready.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep lining folks up and repeat the full plan as soon as it’s set.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll keep sorting the donated items and set aside anything that needs tools or spare parts. Let me know what you want me to tackle next.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Uli: That sounds perfect, Mara — please set aside the tool jobs and any small fixes that need spare parts. I’ll bring my toolbox and help where I can for a few hours.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Mara: Great, Uli — I’ll set those tool jobs and small fixes aside for you. Thanks for bringing your toolbox and a few hours to help.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Mara: Got it — I’ll sort the donated items and set aside the tool jobs and anything needing spare parts. Then I’ll make a quick list of what still needs fixing.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — that’s perfect. I’ll make sure everyone gets the updated Sunday community center details and your list so we stay organized.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll get that list to you as soon as I’ve sorted through everything. That should help keep the repair drive moving smoothly.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Mara: Hi Cleo — I’m still sorting the repair drive details, but I can set aside the small fixes and tool jobs. If you’ve got any parts lists or updates, send them my way.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mara — I’ve got a few spare tools and some tape set aside, and I’ll send over any parts list I have.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — that’ll help a lot. Send the parts list when you can, and I’ll keep the small fixes and tool jobs ready.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll be there to help sort the drop-off spot and keep track of what comes in.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Mara: Great, Dane — that’ll make sorting much easier. I’ll keep you posted on anything that needs parts or a tool job.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Dane: Perfect — send me anything that needs parts or a tool job, and I’ll keep the drop-off spot organized.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Mara: Got it — I’m still sorting the donated items and setting aside the tool jobs and anything needing spare parts. If you’ve got updates or parts lists, send them my way.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Mara — I’ve got a couple of updates, and I can help with the first tool job. Just tell me what you need checked first.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Mina — please start with the first tool job and check for any missing parts. If you spot anything odd, send me the update right away.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Mara: Got it, Sam — I’ll sort the donated items, pull out anything needing tools or spare parts, and then make a quick list of the fixes still needed.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Sam: Perfect, Mara — once you’ve got that list, I can help match each item to the right tools or parts.

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — I’ll get that list to you as soon as I’ve sorted everything.
